title: Verify a source comment anchor
responsibility: Check that an anchor belongs to reachable source, a recognized unit and any named design version or image.

inputs.name: validateGitHubAnchor.deps
inputs.description: Source adapter and transport used to resolve and attest source and ancestry.

inputs.name: validateGitHubAnchor.input
inputs.description: Anchor naming branch, exact commit and unit, with optional design version and image metadata.

outputs.name: validateGitHubAnchor
outputs.description: Resolves without a value after validating branch ancestry, the unit or plan, and any requested design image hash.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Rejects invalid or unreachable anchors, invalid source JSON, inconsistent or ambiguous unit plans, invalid design versions or images and image-integrity failures.
